'''Miwy Joy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was one of [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla's]] [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|freedom fighters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she was one of the Twi'leks that were massacred by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces during the initial stages of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. After her [[Death/Legends|death]], Miwy Joy was among the freedom fighters that were buried in a graveyard on [[Ryloth/Legends|their homeworld]]. Her name was inscribed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on the gravestone.<ref name="TCW Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>
